en.title: Flap Boost
en.subtitle: Set your rule, fund the vault, and let buybacks run on schedule.
en.labels.signalPulseHint: Visualizes automation activity, not price data.
en.labels.randomHoldersPerRound: up to {count} generated addresses per round
en.workflow.createDetail: Set the CA and fixed rules
en.workflow.fundDetail: All operations for this token use one BNB pool
en.workflow.scheduleDetail: Enough BNB queues the next round
en.sections.addOperation: Add an operation for this token
en.modes.fixedBnbDetail: Buy with a fixed BNB amount each round.
en.modes.tokenAmountDetail: Set a token target; BNB follows the live quote.
en.modes.balanceShareDetail: Buy with a share of the Vault's available BNB.
en.placeholders.fixedRecipients: One 0x address per line, up to 5
en.states.wrongNetwork: Switch to {chain} before sending a transaction.
en.states.submittingOnchain: Confirm the transaction in your wallet
en.states.waitingCallbackHint: Status refreshes after confirmation. Automatic rounds continue on-chain.
en.states.actionsUnavailable: Market data is unavailable. Creating and starting buybacks are paused; fund management remains available.
en.states.connectWalletToRead: Connect your wallet to view operations
en.states.taskReadFailed: Could not load operations. Please try again.
en.states.readStateHint: Connect your wallet and wait for operations to load. If loading fails, please try again.
en.states.noTokenOperations: No operation for this token yet.
en.states.needsFundingHint: Add BNB to cover the next round and Trigger fee. Funding automatically retries booking.
en.states.rulesQueued: Changes are queued. The already-booked round will finish under its original rules; the new rules take effect afterward.
en.states.scheduledHint: A round is booked. It runs automatically; no extra scheduling transaction is needed.
en.states.triggerFailedHint: The Trigger service marked this request as failed. The owner can release its reserved BNB and book a new request; the previous service fee is not refunded.
en.states.readyToSchedule: No round is booked. Funding retries automatically; very small rounds wait under the Trigger fee guard.
en.states.feeGuardHint: Each buyback round must be at least {multiplier} times the Trigger fee. Set at least {amount} BNB per round for automatic scheduling.
en.states.feeGuardCapHint: The per-round BNB cap is below the Trigger fee rule. Set the cap to at least {amount} BNB or leave it empty; each buyback round must reach {multiplier} times the Trigger fee.
en.states.startHint: Funding can start the first buyback in the same transaction when the balance is sufficient.
en.states.pausedHint: This operation is paused. Reserved BNB stays locked until the booked callback arrives.
en.states.closedHint: This operation is closed. Shared BNB stays in the Vault and can be withdrawn separately.
en.help.taskList: Operations for the same token share one Vault BNB balance and one Trigger queue.
en.help.tokenWorkspace: Every operation buys this token with BNB; choose what happens to the bought tokens: burn, distribute, or retain. You can run several operations for one CA.
en.help.separateOperationFunds: One token has one Vault. All its operations draw from the same BNB pool; the first start fee is charged only once for that Vault. Due operations run in order, and an unaffordable next operation waits for more funding.
en.help.existingTokenCreate: This token CA is fixed for the new operation. Its Portal quote is refreshed before you create it.
en.help.operation.distribute: Send bought tokens to entered or generated addresses.
en.help.operation.retain: Buy tokens and send them to one wallet you choose.
en.help.noTokenOperations: Choose an operation above. Fund the token Vault once, then explicitly start each operation after checking its balance.
en.help.noTasks: Add a token, set its rules, then fund to start the first round.
en.help.buybackMode: The buyback method is fixed at creation; amounts and intervals can be edited later.
en.help.percentageSchedulingBalance: Later automatic rounds need at least {amount} BNB in the Vault at the current Trigger fee.
en.help.retain: Tokens from every completed buyback go to this address.
en.help.recipients: One recipient per line, up to five. This only increases the on-chain holder count if a receiving address had zero tokens before distribution; it does not find new holders automatically.
en.help.distributionMode: Choose fixed addresses you enter, or random holder addresses generated for every completed round.
en.help.randomHolders: Up to 20 generated addresses per round. These addresses have no usable private keys: tokens sent to them cannot be recovered. They are not real participating users.
en.help.taskOverview: The owner can edit the per-round amount, interval, and token handling. The buyback method and token CA stay fixed.
en.help.editRules: Saving rules automatically attempts to book the next round. If a round is already booked, changes take effect after it finishes.
en.help.triggerFeeMinimum: Each buyback round must be at least {multiplier} times the Trigger fee. The current minimum is {amount} BNB per round.
en.help.triggerFeeMinimumWarning: Each buyback round must be at least {multiplier} times the Trigger fee. Set at least {amount} BNB per round for automatic scheduling.
en.help.editOutputRisk: The task owner can redirect tokens from future rounds to a new recipient. Anyone funding this task must trust its owner.
en.help.editModeFixed: This execution method is fixed for the lifetime of the task.
en.help.firstDirect: Funding starts the first round when the balance is sufficient. A small deposit stays in the Vault for your next top-up; later rounds use Trigger automatically.
en.errors.targetToken: Enter a valid target-token contract address.
en.errors.loadTokenFirst: Load a valid token CA first so the token amount uses the right decimals.
en.errors.tokenMetadata: Token decimals could not be verified. Reload the token before continuing.
en.errors.amountPrecision: The amount has more decimal places than this token supports.
en.errors.priceFloor: This CA does not currently have a usable Flap quote, so a buyback task cannot be created.
en.errors.targetLookup: This CA could not be read as a token.
en.errors.roundBelowTriggerMinimum: Set at least {amount} BNB per round to meet the Trigger fee rule.
en.errors.capBelowTriggerMinimum: Set the per-round BNB cap to at least {amount} BNB, or leave it empty.
en.errors.triggerFeeUnavailable: The Trigger fee could not be read. Refresh before creating this rule.
en.errors.interval: The interval must be at least one minute.
en.errors.fixedRecipients: Enter one to five distinct valid addresses.
en.errors.randomHolders: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
en.errors.funding: Enter a valid BNB funding amount.
en.errors.startFunds: Add BNB to cover the first round and any unpaid setup fee. Booked BNB is unavailable.
en.errors.factoryRead: The Factory task list could not be read. Confirm that this Mini App is using the new Factory on the active chain.
en.errors.simulation: Pre-transaction check failed. Verify the task state, BNB amount, and token CA.
en.errors.tx: Transaction failed. Check the wallet prompt and the on-chain task state.
en.errors.walletRejected: The wallet request was cancelled. No transaction was sent.
en.errors.walletDisconnected: Connect your wallet before sending the transaction.
en.errors.wrongNetwork: Switch your wallet to the Vault's network and try again.
en.errors.insufficientWalletBalance: Your wallet needs enough BNB for both the deposit and network gas.
en.errors.reverted: The transaction reverted on-chain. No changes were saved.
en.errors.contractRejected: The contract rejected this operation. No changes were saved.
en.errors.gasLimitTooLarge: The wallet submitted a gas limit above this network's limit. Reset custom gas settings and try again.
en.errors.taskUnavailable: This operation is currently unavailable. Refresh its status.
en.messages.vaultCreated: Vault and its first buyback rule created. Fund it to start.
en.messages.rulesUpdated: Rules saved; the Vault automatically checked whether it can book the next round.
en.messages.taskFunded: BNB has been added to the shared token Vault.
en.messages.taskFundedAndMaybeStarted: BNB added. The first round was attempted if the balance covered it; the status has refreshed.
en.messages.triggerRecovered: Failed Trigger recovered. The schedule has refreshed.
en.messages.taskClosed: Operation closed. Shared Vault BNB remains available to the other operations and can be withdrawn by the owner.
en.messages.checked: Scheduling check confirmed. Refreshed the queue state.
en.messages.started: Start transaction confirmed. Refreshed the actual execution state.
en.nav.createHint: Choose a token, set the buyback rule, then create on-chain.
en.nav.mineHint: Select a token and operation to fund, monitor, or adjust its rules.
en.plaza.heroSubtitle: Explore public buyback projects and follow their on-chain progress. No wallet connection required.
en.plaza.title: Buyback projects
en.plaza.description: Project status and cumulative results, read directly from the current Factory and Vaults.
en.plaza.search: Search token symbol, CA, owner, or Vault address
en.plaza.factoryUnavailable: A Factory is not configured for this network yet, so public projects cannot be listed here.
en.plaza.readFailed: The current Factory does not expose public project pages, or the network read failed. This plaza requires the updated Factory.
en.plaza.noProjects: No buyback projects on this network yet
en.plaza.emptyFactoryHint: Projects will appear here after their Vault is created on this network.
en.plaza.noRunning: No running projects in the loaded pages
en.plaza.noMatch: No matching projects in the loaded pages
en.plaza.noMatchHint: Try a shorter symbol or address, or load more projects.
en.plaza.emptyHint: Try all projects or load more from the Factory.
en.plaza.partialHistory: Showing recent Factory projects; load more to include older Vaults.
en.plaza.chainSource: Read from the on-chain Factory registry and Vault state.
en.help.emptyIntro: Choose a token and a buyback rule. The Factory creates its Vault in the same transaction; fund it to start.
en.states.staleRead: Refresh failed. Showing the last loaded data; retry before sending a transaction.
en.states.queuedHint: Operation #{id} already has the shared queue slot. This operation waits its turn.
en.help.connectToCreate: Use the wallet connection at the top of the page. You can prepare the form first.
en.help.createThenFund: Create the operation, then fund the shared pool to start its first round.
en.help.newVaultCreate: One transaction deploys the Vault for this token and saves its first buyback rule.
en.help.sharedFunds: All operations for this token use this pool. Withdrawals affect their available budget.
en.help.reservedFunds: Only available BNB can be withdrawn. Booked funds are released by the callback, including after pause or closure.
en.help.closeOperation: Close this operation permanently? Other operations keep running. Shared BNB stays in the Vault; booked funds wait for their callback.
en.help.pendingOutput: Operation #{id} has {amount} {symbol} awaiting delivery. New rounds wait until this output is settled.
en.help.retryStatus: {count} consecutive failures. The contract backs off before retrying; check the budget, price protection, and recipient.
en.help.priceProtection: The minimum tokens per BNB is fixed at creation using 70% of the creation-time quote. It is a lasting price floor, not a fresh slippage tolerance each round.
en.help.startFee: The first start in this token Vault pays a one-time {amount} BNB fee. Later operations share the same paid setup.
en.errors.operationLimit: This token Vault already has 24 operations, including closed ones. It cannot add another.
en.errors.percentage: Enter a percentage from 0.01 to 100, with at most two decimal places.
en.messages.outputRetried: Delivery retry confirmed. Refreshed the output state.

zh.title: Flap Boost
zh.subtitle: 设定规则、充入资金，按你的节奏自动回购。
zh.labels.signalPulseHint: 仅表示自动执行活动，不代表价格数据。
zh.labels.randomHoldersPerRound: 每轮最多 {count} 个生成地址
zh.labels.randomHoldersTotal: 累计分发到 {count} 个地址
zh.workflow.createDetail: 设置 CA 与固定回购规则
zh.workflow.fundDetail: 同一代币的全部操作共享这笔 BNB
zh.workflow.scheduleDetail: BNB 足够时自动预约下一轮
zh.workflow.outputDetail: 销毁、留存或固定地址分发
zh.modes.fixedBnbDetail: 每轮按固定 BNB 金额回购。
zh.modes.tokenAmountDetail: 指定买入数量，BNB 按实时报价计算。
zh.modes.balanceShareDetail: 每轮按 Vault 可用 BNB 的比例回购。
zh.placeholders.targetToken: 输入 0x 代币合约地址
zh.placeholders.fixedRecipients: 每行一个 0x 地址，最多 5 个
zh.states.wrongNetwork: 请先切换到 {chain} 再发送交易。
zh.states.waitingCallbackHint: 确认后自动刷新；后续回购由链上任务继续执行。
zh.states.actionsUnavailable: 市场数据暂不可用，创建和启动回购暂受限；资金管理仍可使用。
zh.states.connectWalletToRead: 连接钱包，查看你的操作
zh.states.readStateHint: 连接钱包后等待操作加载；若读取失败，请重试。
zh.states.needsFundingHint: 请补足下一轮回购金额和 Trigger 服务费；充值后会自动尝试预约。
zh.states.rulesQueued: 修改已排队：当前已预约的一轮仍按原规则执行，结束后新规则才生效。
zh.states.scheduledHint: 已预约下一轮，将自动执行，无需重复预约。
zh.states.triggerFailedHint: Trigger 服务已将本次预约标记为失败。创建者可释放预留 BNB 并重新预约；已支付的服务费不退还。
zh.states.readyToSchedule: 当前没有已预约轮次。充值会自动尝试预约；单轮金额过小时会受 Trigger 服务费保护而暂缓。
zh.states.feeGuardHint: 回购金额必须至少是 Trigger 服务费的 {multiplier} 倍。每轮至少设为 {amount} BNB 才能自动预约。
zh.states.feeGuardCapHint: 每轮 BNB 上限低于预约门槛。回购金额至少要达到 Trigger 服务费的 {multiplier} 倍；请把上限设为至少 {amount} BNB，或留空不设上限。
zh.states.startHint: 充值足额时，同一笔交易会启动首轮回购。
zh.states.pausedHint: 这个操作已暂停；已预约资金需等回调到达后释放。
zh.states.closedHint: 操作已关闭。共享 BNB 仍在金库，可单独提取。
zh.help.taskList: 同一代币的多个操作共用一个 Vault 余额和一条 Trigger 队列。
zh.help.tokenWorkspace: 每种操作都会用 BNB 回购这个代币，区别是买入后销毁、分发还是留存。同一 CA 可以同时运行多条操作。
zh.help.separateOperationFunds: 一个代币对应一个 Vault，全部操作共用 BNB；首次启动费对这个 Vault 只收一次。操作按到期顺序执行，下一个余额不足时等待充值。
zh.help.existingTokenCreate: 新操作沿用当前代币 CA；创建前会重新读取 Portal 报价。
zh.help.operation.distribute: 买入后分给指定地址或随机生成地址。
zh.help.operation.retain: 买入代币后转入一个指定钱包。
zh.help.noTokenOperations: 在上方创建操作；充值足额后同一笔交易可启动首轮。
zh.help.noTasks: 添加代币并设置规则，创建后充值即可启动首轮。
zh.help.buybackMode: 回购方式创建后固定，数量和间隔仍可编辑。
zh.help.percentageSchedulingBalance: 按当前 Trigger 费用，后续自动预约需 Vault 余额至少 {amount} BNB。
zh.help.retain: 每轮回购所得代币都会转入这个地址。
zh.help.recipients: 每行一个接收地址，最多 5 个。只有接收前余额为零的地址收到代币后，链上持有人数才可能增加；合约不会自动寻找新持有人。
zh.help.distributionMode: 固定地址由你填写；随机增加持有人会在每次回购完成时生成一批随机地址。
zh.help.randomHolders: 每轮最多生成 20 个地址。这些地址没有可用私钥，收到的代币无法找回，也不代表新增真实用户。
zh.help.taskOverview: 可修改每轮金额、间隔和买入后处理；回购方式与代币 CA 固定。
zh.help.editRules: 保存规则后会自动尝试预约下一轮；如当前一轮已预约，新规则会在该轮结束后生效。
zh.help.triggerFeeMinimum: 回购金额必须至少是 Trigger 服务费的 {multiplier} 倍。当前每轮最低 {amount} BNB。
zh.help.triggerFeeMinimumWarning: 回购金额必须至少是 Trigger 服务费的 {multiplier} 倍。每轮至少设为 {amount} BNB 才能自动预约。
zh.help.editOutputRisk: 任务创建者可修改以后轮次的收币地址。给此任务充值的人需要信任任务创建者。
zh.help.editModeFixed: 任务创建时选定的回购方式不可切换。
zh.help.firstDirect: 充值足额时会在同一笔交易中尝试首轮回购；不足额的 BNB 留在金库，补足时再自动尝试。后续由 Trigger 自动预约。
zh.errors.targetToken: 请输入有效的目标代币合约地址。
zh.errors.loadTokenFirst: 请先加载有效 CA，确保按正确精度填写代币数量。
zh.errors.tokenMetadata: 未能确认代币精度，请重新加载 CA 后继续。
zh.errors.amountPrecision: 输入的小数位超出了代币支持的精度。
zh.errors.priceFloor: 暂时无法读取这个 CA 的 Flap 报价，因此不能创建回购任务。请确认代币已在 Flap 市场可报价。
zh.errors.targetLookup: 无法将这个 CA 读取为代币。
zh.errors.amount: 请输入有效的正数数量。
zh.errors.roundBelowTriggerMinimum: 每轮至少设为 {amount} BNB，才能满足 Trigger 服务费规则。
zh.errors.capBelowTriggerMinimum: 每轮 BNB 上限至少设为 {amount} BNB，或留空不设上限。
zh.errors.triggerFeeUnavailable: 暂时无法读取 Trigger 服务费，请刷新后再创建这条规则。
zh.errors.interval: 执行间隔至少为 1 分钟。
zh.errors.retainWallet: 请输入有效的留存钱包地址。
zh.errors.fixedRecipients: 请输入 1 到 5 个互不重复的有效地址。
zh.errors.randomHolders: 请输入 1 到 20 的整数。
zh.errors.funding: 请输入有效的 BNB 充值数量。
zh.errors.withdraw: 请输入有效的未使用 BNB 数量。
zh.errors.startFunds: 请补充 BNB，覆盖首轮回购和未支付的启动费；已预约部分不可用于首轮。
zh.errors.factoryRead: 无法读取 Factory 的任务列表。请确认 Mini App 已使用当前网络上的新版 Factory。
zh.errors.simulation: 交易预检查失败。请检查任务状态、BNB 数量和代币 CA。
zh.errors.tx: 交易失败。请检查钱包确认和链上任务状态。
zh.errors.walletRejected: 钱包请求已取消，交易没有发出。
zh.errors.walletDisconnected: 请先连接钱包再发送交易。
zh.errors.wrongNetwork: 请把钱包切换到该 Vault 所在网络后重试。
zh.errors.insufficientWalletBalance: 钱包中的 BNB 需要同时覆盖充值金额和网络手续费。
zh.errors.reverted: 交易已在链上回滚，状态没有改变。
zh.errors.contractRejected: 合约未接受本次操作，状态没有改变。
zh.errors.gasLimitTooLarge: 钱包提交的 Gas 上限超过网络限制。请重置钱包自定义 Gas 设置后重试。
zh.errors.onlyOwner: 请使用该 Vault 所有者的钱包。
zh.errors.taskUnavailable: 该操作当前不可执行，请刷新状态。
zh.messages.vaultCreated: Vault 与首条回购规则已创建，充值后即可启动。
zh.messages.rulesUpdated: 规则已保存，Vault 已自动检查下一轮预约条件。
zh.messages.taskFunded: BNB 已充值到该代币的共享 Vault。
zh.messages.taskFundedAndMaybeStarted: BNB 已充值；余额足够时已尝试首轮回购，状态已刷新。
zh.messages.triggerRecovered: 失败预约已恢复，队列状态已刷新。
zh.messages.withdrawn: 未使用 BNB 已提取。
zh.messages.taskClosed: 操作已关闭。共享 Vault 余额仍可供其他操作使用，创建者也可提取。
zh.messages.checked: 预约检查已确认，队列状态已刷新。
zh.messages.started: 启动交易已确认，实际执行状态已刷新。

zh.nav.mineHint: 选择代币和操作，查看状态、管理资金与规则。

zh.plaza.partialHistory: 当前展示最近创建的项目；可继续加载较早的 Vault。

zh.help.emptyIntro: 选择代币和回购规则，Factory 会在同一笔交易创建 Vault；之后充值即可启动。
zh.states.staleRead: 刷新失败，当前显示上次读取的数据；请重试后再操作。
zh.states.queuedHint: 共享队列已为操作 #{id} 预约；当前操作按到期顺序等待。
zh.help.connectToCreate: 使用页面顶部的钱包连接入口；也可以先准备回购规则。
zh.help.createThenFund: 创建后充值共享资金，足额即可启动首轮回购。
zh.help.newVaultCreate: 一笔交易完成：为该代币部署 Vault，并写入首条回购规则。
zh.help.rulePreview: 随填写实时变化 · 未发起交易

zh.labels.existingVault: 现有 VAULT / 新增规则
zh.help.sharedFunds: 该代币的全部操作共用这笔资金；提现会减少其他操作的可用预算。
zh.help.reservedFunds: 只能提取可用 BNB；已预约部分需等回调释放，暂停或关闭也不会立即解锁。
zh.help.closeOperation: 确认永久关闭这个操作？其他操作继续运行，BNB 留在共享金库；已预约部分需等待回调释放。
zh.help.pendingOutput: 操作 #{id} 有 {amount} {symbol} 等待转出；处理完成前，新的回购轮次会等待。
zh.help.retryStatus: 已连续失败 {count} 次，合约会延后重试；请检查预算、价格保护和接收地址。
zh.help.priceProtection: 每 BNB 最低买入数量按创建时报价的 70% 固定；这是长期价格底线，不是每轮重新计算的滑点。价格超出保护范围时会重试。
zh.help.startFee: 该代币金库首次启动收取 {amount} BNB 一次性费用，后续操作不重复收取。
zh.errors.operationLimit: 该代币金库已达到 24 个操作上限，已关闭的操作也占名额，无法继续新增。
zh.errors.percentage: 请输入 0.01 至 100 的比例，最多保留两位小数。
zh.messages.outputRetried: 转出重试交易已确认，处理状态已刷新。
